notes.title: DON'T WATCH: Release Date & Extra Endings!
notes.content:

notes.title: 2 DAYS UNTIL THE RELEASE
notes.content:
We still can't believe that we're only 48 hours away from the release of BrokenLore: LOW!

🗓️ Mark your calendars:
🕛 Release Date: February 20th, 12:30 PM Pacific

This is the first title in the BrokenLore saga, and we truly appreciate your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046088/9abf6a1b8f0b91a9563d07d3b84bd26ac98d9d7e.jpg[/img]

GAME ELEMENTS: 
[list]
[*] The game is set in the 2000s and takes you to the remote village of Kirisame (霧雨村)
[*] The game blends hyper-realistic graphics with retro aesthetics.
[*] It features statues by Italian sculptor [i]Bruno Lucchi[/i].
[/list]

notes.title: NEW RETRO TEASER for BrokenLore: LOW
notes.content:
Long ago, in a remote Japanese village, a mother discovered a mirror unlike any other. What secrets does it hold?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046088/857e0830754c45b1bc09e2db31effea3056c36e6.gif[/img]

Venture into the forgotten village of Kirasame, where hyper-realistic visuals blend with classic, old-school graphics. These visual elements are more than just a backdrop—they are crucial to the unfolding mystery.

A major announcement is coming next week, on January 23rd!
来月の木曜日に大きな発表があります！お楽しみに！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046088/4490afff4bcdd96dcbd22023a2a350dbcc904b9a.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]LOW[/b][/url] is only one of the entries in their new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][i][b]BrokenLore[/b][/i][/url] series that focus on philosophical themes and psychological horror.
